#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> multiply(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int n = 1;
    while (n < need) n <<= 1;

    vector<double> ar(n, 0.0), ai(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> br(n, 0.0), bi(n, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        long long x = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        ar[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
        ai[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
        long long x = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
        br[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
        bi[i] = x >> 15;
    }

    // FFT
    auto fft = [](vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inv) {
        int n = re.size();
        int bits = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_reverse(i) >> bits;
            if (i < j) {
                swap(re[i], re[j]);
                swap(im[i], im[j]);
            }
        }

        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                    double angle = 2 * M_PI * j / len;
                    double wRe = cos(angle);
                    double wIm = inv ? -sin(angle) : sin(angle);

                    double uRe = re[i + j];
                    double uIm = im[i + j];
                    double vRe = re[i + j + half] * wRe - im[i + j + half] * wIm;
                    double vIm = re[i + j + half] * wIm + im[i + j + half] * wRe;

                    re[i + j] = uRe + vRe;
                    im[i + j] = uIm + vIm;
                    re[i + j + half] = uRe - vRe;
                    im[i + j + half] = uIm - vIm;
                }
            }
        }

        if (inv) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] /= n;
                im[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    };

    fft(ar, ai, false);
    fft(br, bi, false);

    vector<double> res1r(n), res1i(n);
    vector<double> res2r(n), res2i(n);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        double a1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5;

        double b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5;

        res1r[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        res1i[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        res2r[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        res2i[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    fft(res1r, res1i, true);
    fft(res2r, res2i, true);

    vector<int> result(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = llround(res1r[i]);
        long long bb = llround(res2r[i]);
        long long cc = llround(res1i[i]);
        result[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return result;
}

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& in;
    char buf[1024];
    int ptr, len;

public:
    InputReader(istream& is) : in(is) {
        ptr = 0;
        len = 0;
    }

    int read() {
        if (len == -1) throw runtime_error("EOF");
        if (ptr >= len) {
            ptr = 0;
            in.read(buf, sizeof(buf));
            len = in.gcount();
            if (len <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[ptr++] & 0xFF;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (c <= 32) c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int val = 0;
        while (c > 32) {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("Invalid number");
            val = val * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        }
        return val * sign;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        v[in.nextInt()] = 1;
    }
    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int exp = n / 2;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            ans = multiply(ans, v, MOD);
        }
        v = multiply(v, v, MOD);
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    long long total = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        total = (total + (long long)x * x) % MOD;
    }
    cout << total << endl;
    return 0;
}
